Lowercase "don't replace assurance" survives normalization with source provenance.
Equivalent uppercase and lowercase prohibitions produce semantically equivalent prohibition assertions.
program-execution.intent.v1 does not dead-end merely because the campaign router refuses that internal kind.
Architecture input: every materially relevant source unit receives an explicit disposition.
Requested functionality already present can be ALREADY_SATISFIED / KEEP / HARDEN_WIRE_EXISTING instead of CREATE.
Unknown implementation seam does not fabricate a mutation path.
Authority-bearing ambiguity: uncertainty does not become permission.
Shadow compilation produces no repository/runtime execution side effect.
Comparator reports semantic differences independently of exact generated wording.
Explicit valid PEC canonical input remains compatible through unified ingress.
Malformed or unsafe source fails before execution side effects.

already-implemented functionality → grounding recognizes it → no false CREATE
authority-bearing ambiguity → UNKNOWN / blocked / escalation → no authority widening
safe ambiguity resolvable from repo truth → grounding resolves → compilation continues

bootstrap_bridge.rule: Do not build a competing orchestrator. Dual lane: trusted explicit contract + Claude/model execution; same raw intent through PEC shadow compile → semantic conformance report.
bootstrap_bridge.source_intent: 00-source-intent.md is immutable and hashed; every downstream requirement keeps file+span provenance
bootstrap_bridge.contract_drift: If live repo contradicts the contract: emit CONTRACT_DRIFT with exact path/symbol, observed behavior, why the contract is stale, recommended converged action. Safe equivalent may adapt; material architecture difference STOP. Do not recreate a superseded component.

launchability_rule: After Blueprint seal, launchability is ASSERT ONLY. Do not let launchability discover missing semantics and mutate the compiled artifact. Characterize the current write-back smell in W1; do not rewrite launchability in this plan.
